canonical_format: For each selected row in original CSV order: ordinal_0based,agency,component,vector\n (without header), UTF-8
verified_via: GitHub fetch_blob returns entire decoded UTF-8 CSV. Re-encoding to UTF-8 produced 3,132,295 bytes, whose Git blob SHA-1 exactly matched the official blob SHA-1. Independently decoded rows and reclassified 8 fields; both original-derived 227-row canonical SHA-1 fingerprints matched previously saved status-matrix fingerprints computed locally.
limitation: Complete original CSV was read and byte-authenticated in the connector runtime, but was not persisted as a physical file in this working container because direct file download was unavailable. Full local Python file-based rerun is included as a reproducibility script, not claimed as executed here.
